## Bone Crawler (CR 12)

**XP** 19,200  
 N Huge aberration  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** blindsight 60 ft.; Perception +15  

**Defense**

 **AC** 12, touch 12, flat-footed 8 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, –2 size);  
 or  
 **AC** 18, touch 8, flat-footed 18 (+10 natural armor, –2 size) in bone armor  
 **hp** 156 (12d8+60)  
 **Fort** +13; **Ref** +9; **Will** +10  
 **Defensive Abilities** bone armor, cannot be flanked; **SR**23  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft. in bone armor (30 ft. base); climb 10 ft.  
 **Melee** up to 12 bone blades +16 (1d8+8/19–20) and/or up to 12 whipfronds +15 (1d4+8)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** bone blades, whipfronds, whirling frenzy  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 26, **Dex** 16, **Con** 21, **Int** 9, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 9  
 **Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 33  
 **Feats** Cleave, Improved Critical (bone blade), Lightning Reflexes, Lunge, Weapon Focus (bone blade), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +9, Climb +25 (+15 in bone armor), Disguise +5 (+15 disguised as mound of bones), Perception +15, Stealth +8; **Racial Modifiers** when in bone armor, a bone crawler gains a +10 on disguise checks to resemble a mound of bones, and takes a –10 armor check penalty on Climb checks  
 **Languages** Aklo  

**Special Abilities**

 **Bone Armor (Ex)** The bone crawler is normally encountered encased in a shell of iron-hard bones. This shell has a hardness of 10, takes half damage from energy attacks (except sonic attacks) and has hit points equal to 10 x (HD + 1.) Bone armor weighs 1 pound per hit point. It can take damage like any object, though it receives the bone crawler’s saving throws and spell resistance. Unlike carried objects, area of effect attacks require the bone crawler to roll a separate saving throw for its bone armor, even if it makes the saving throw itself. Spell resistance is checked just once for the overall creature and its armor, however. While it bears bone armor, the bone crawler receives no bonus to AC for its Dexterity.
